intro: Redefine dining with the Kalyx bench—a space-saving marvel. With its soft cushioning and sleek design, it offers versatile seating that’s as perfect for family dinners as it is for impromptu chats​.

features.title: Space-saving design with a gentle look
features.text: Short on space? We’ve got you covered. Compact and visually subtle, the Kalya Bench fits smaller dining areas perfectly, saving space while keeping you comfortable.

features.title: Soft fabric upholstery for comfortable seating
features.text: Sink in and stay comfortable. Upholstered in dark brown fabric, this chair offers both comfort and understated elegance.

features.title: Powder-coated black metal legs for durability
features.text: No more worrying about scratches—the black powder-coated metal legs are tough enough for everyday use.

features.title: Knockdown construction for easy assembly
features.text: Life moves fast—knockdown construction makes this bench easy to assemble, relocate, and fit your lifestyle.

features.title: Neutral black finish to match versatile décor
features.text: The neutral black finish easily complements various interior styles, making it versatile for any room.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
